' };
  const HD_L6 = { bg:makeImg(HD_L6_SRC.bg) };
  let level6PreloadPromise = null;
  function level6AssetsReady(){ return HD_L6.bg&&HD_L6.bg.complete&&HD_L6.bg.naturalWidth>0&&level1AssetsReady()&&level4AssetsReady(); }
  function preloadLevel6HD(){
    if(level6AssetsReady()) return Promise.resolve(true);
    if(level6PreloadPromise) return level6PreloadPromise;
    level6PreloadPromise=Promise.all([HD_L6.bg,...Object.values(HD_L1),...Object.values(HD_L4)].map(img=>new Promise(resolve=>{
      if(img.complete&&img.naturalWidth>0) return resolve(true);
      const done=()=>resolve(true),fail=()=>resolve(false);
      img.addEventListener('load',done,{once:true}); img.addEventListener('error',fail,{once:true});

  }
  preloadLevel6HD();
  function isLevel6HD(){ return state&&state.mode!=='endless'&&state.levelIndex===5; }
  function drawLevel6NightEffects(){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    for(let i=0;i<32;i++){
      const s=state.starscape[i%state.starscape.length];
      if(!s) continue;
      const a=.18+(.5+.5*Math.sin(s.tw+i))* .42;
      ctx.globalAlpha=a; ctx.fillStyle=i%5===0?'#fff2a6':'#e9f4ff';
      const r=i%7===0?2.6:1.25+(i%3)*.35;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,(s.y*.72)%620,r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      if(i%8===0){
        ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,244,190,.55)';ctx.lineWidth=1.1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(s.x-5,(s.y*.72)%620);ctx.lineTo(s.x+5,(s.y*.72)%620);ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    // Shooting stars: purely visual, no collision.
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
      const cycle=(state.time*(72+i*16)+i*240)%(W+420);
      const x=W+150-cycle, y=115+i*135+Math.sin(state.time*.6+i)*22;
      const len=52+i*10;
      const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(x,y,x+len,y-len*.52);
      g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.95)');g.addColorStop(.22,'rgba(185,222,255,.72)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(130,185,255,0)');
      ctx.strokeStyle=g;ctx.lineWidth=1.8+i*.35;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y);ctx.lineTo(x+len,y-len*.52);ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.95)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,2.2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawLevel6BackdropHD(){

  // LEVEL 7 — ROYAUME DE NEIGE HD

  let level7PreloadPromise=null;

  function drawLevel7SnowEffects(){
    ctx.save();
    for(let i=0;i<58;i++){
      const seed=i*41.73;
      const depth=(i%3)+1;
      const x=((seed*13 + state.time*(18+depth*12))%(W+80))-40;
      const y=((seed*29 + state.time*(34+depth*24))%(H+100))-50;
      const r=.8+depth*.75;

      ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.shadowColor='rgba(220,244,255,.7)';ctx.shadowBlur=depth*2;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
      if(i%9===0){ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.55)';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-4,y);ctx.lineTo(x+4,y);ctx.moveTo(x,y-4);ctx.lineTo(x,y+4);ctx.stroke();}
    }

    for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
      const xx=(W+120-((state.time*(62+i*12)+i*170)%(W+260))); const yy=210+i*155+Math.sin(state.time*.8+i)*18;
      const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(xx,yy,xx+92,yy-12);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(220,246,255,0)');g.addColorStop(.4,'rgba(235,250,255,.38)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
      ctx.strokeStyle=g;ctx.lineWidth=2+i*.35;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(xx,yy);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(xx+48,yy-18,xx+92,yy-5);ctx.stroke();
    }

  function drawLevel7BackdropHD(){

  function isLevel1HD(){

  function drawSpriteCenter(img, rect, cx, cy, scale=1, rot=0, alpha=1, flip=false, anchorX=.5, anchorY=.5){
    if(!img || !img.complete || !img.naturalWidth) return false;
    const [sx,sy,sw,sh] = rect;
    const dw = sw * scale, dh = sh * scale;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    ctx.rotate(rot || 0);
    ctx.scale(flip ? -1 : 1, 1);
    ctx.drawImage(img, sx, sy, sw, sh, -dw*anchorX, -dh*anchorY, dw, dh);
    ctx.restore();
    return true;
  }
  function drawImageCover(img, driftX=0, driftY=0, alpha=1){
    if(!img || !img.complete || !img.naturalWidth) return false;
    const scale = Math.max(W / img.naturalWidth, H / img.naturalHeight);
    const dw = img.naturalWidth * scale;
    const dh = img.naturalHeight * scale;
    const dx = (W - dw) / 2 + driftX;
    const dy = (H - dh) / 2 + driftY;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.drawImage(img, dx, dy, dw, dh);
    ctx.restore();
    return true;
  }
  function drawLevel1BackdropHD(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

      ctx.fillStyle = skyGradient('day');
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    }
    // readable gameplay overlays
    const topGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H*0.4);
    topGrad.addColorStop(0,'rgba(130,205,255,.10)');
    topGrad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(130,205,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = topGrad; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    drawCloudLayer(state.farClouds, 'day', .78);
    state.farIslands.forEach(i=>drawIsland(i, 'day', true));
    drawCloudLayer(state.midClouds, 'day', .95);
    state.nearIslands.forEach(i=>drawIsland(i, 'day', false));
    drawWind();
    drawCloudLayer(state.nearClouds, 'day', 1.18);
    drawBottomFog();

  function loadProgress(){
    const base = { unlocked: 1, endlessUnlocked: true, levels: {}, bestEndless: 0, difficulty:'normal', lastLevel:0 };
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || 'null');
      return saved ? Object.assign(base, saved) : base;
    } catch(e){ return base; }
  }  function saveProgress(){
    try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state.progressData)); }
    catch(e) { /* local-file/private mode: gameplay continues without persistence */ }
  }
  state.progressData = loadProgress();
  state.bestEndless = state.progressData.bestEndless || 0;
  function bestOverallScore(){
    let best = state.progressData.bestEndless || 0;
    const levels = state.progressData.levels || {};
    for(const k of Object.keys(levels)) best = Math.max(best, Number(levels[k]?.best || 0));
    return best;
  }
  function refreshHomeScore(){
    const el=document.getElementById('bestEndless');
    if(el) el.textContent=fmt(bestOverallScore());
  }
  state.difficulty = state.progressData.difficulty === 'easy' ? 'easy' : 'normal';

  function fmt(n){ return String(Math.max(0, Math.floor(n))).padStart(6,'0'); }
  function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }
  function clamp(v,a,b){ return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v)); }

  const FEATHER_BONUS_ASSET_SRC = {
    bouclier: {player:"data:image/webp;base64,",icon:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
    aimant: {player:"data:image/webp;base64,",icon:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
    rafale: {player:"data:image/webp;base64,",icon:"data:image/webp;base64,"},
    foudre: {player:"data:image/webp;base64,",icon:"data:image/webp;base64,"}
  };
  const FEATHER_BONUS_ASSETS = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(FEATHER_BONUS_ASSET_SRC).map(([k,v])=>{
    const player=new Image(),icon=new Image(); player.src=v.player; icon.src=v.icon; return [k,{player,icon}];
  }));
  const FEATHER_BONUSES = {
    bouclier: {name:'Bouclier doré',duration:10,color:'#ffd33f'},
    aimant: {name:'Aimant céleste',duration:8,color:'#31d9ff'},
    rafale: {name:'Rafale',duration:7,color:'#ff8b2d'},
    foudre: {name:'Foudre',duration:6,color:'#8b6cff'}
  };
  function bonusColor(type){ return (FEATHER_BONUSES[type]||FEATHER_BONUSES.bouclier).color; }
  function deactivateFeatherBonus(){
    state.bonusType=null; state.bonusTimer=0; state.bonusShieldHits=0; state.bonusZapCd=0;
  }
  function activateRandomFeatherBonus(){
    const all=Object.keys(FEATHER_BONUSES);
    const choices=all.filter(x=>x!==state.bonusLast);
    const type=choices[Math.floor(Math.random()*choices.length)] || all[Math.floor(Math.random()*all.length)];
    const meta=FEATHER_BONUSES[type];
    state.bonusType=type; state.bonusTimer=meta.duration; state.bonusLast=type;
    state.bonusShieldHits=type==='bouclier'?1:0; state.bonusZapCd=0;
    state.featherCount=0;
    state.flash=Math.max(state.flash,.22);
    state.bonusPulse = 1.18;
    state.bonusBurst = {type, text: meta.name, life: 1.15, time: 0};
    if(state.player){ state.player.cheer=1.08; state.player.wink=.3; }
    const bx=state.player?state.player.x:150, by=state.player?state.player.y:420;
    for(let i=0;i<24;i++) state.particles.push({x:bx,y:by,vx:rand(-145,145),vy:rand(-145,80),r:rand(3,8),life:rand(.65,1.1),type:'bonus',bonusType:type});
    for(let i=0;i<12;i++) state.ribbons.push({x:bx,y:by,vx:rand(-170,170),vy:rand(-180,40),rot:rand(0,6.28),vr:rand(-6,6),len:rand(18,38),w:rand(5,11),life:rand(.55,1.08),bonusType:type});
    showToast(`Bonus : ${meta.name} !`);
  }
  function addBonusPoints(n){
    if(state.mode==='endless') state.score+=n; else state.bonusScore+=n;
  }
  function emitFeatherBonusAmbient(dt){
    const type=state.bonusType, p=state.player;
    if(!type||!p) return;
    const chance = type==='bouclier'?8.5:type==='aimant'?10:type==='rafale'?12:11;
    if(Math.random() < dt*chance){
      const count = type==='rafale'?2:1;
      for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
        const ang = rand(0, Math.PI*2);
        const dist = type==='bouclier' ? rand(44,64) : rand(28,58);
        const drift = type==='rafale' ? rand(80,130) : rand(24,65);
        state.particles.push({
          x:p.x + Math.cos(ang)*dist,
          y:p.y - 8 + Math.sin(ang)*dist*.75,
          vx:Math.cos(ang)*drift + (type==='rafale' ? rand(-25,30) : 0),
          vy:Math.sin(ang)*drift*.38 - rand(6,42),
          r:rand(3,6),
          life:rand(.35,.9),
          type:'bonus',
          bonusType:type
        });
      }
    }
    if(type==='foudre' && Math.random()<dt*8){
      state.sparks.push({x:p.x+rand(-42,42),y:p.y+rand(-56,34),r:rand(1.4,3.1),life:rand(.08,.18)});
    }
  }
  function updateFeatherBonus(dt){
    if(!state.bonusType) return;
    emitFeatherBonusAmbient(dt);
    state.bonusTimer-=dt;
    if(state.bonusType==='foudre'){
      state.bonusZapCd-=dt;
      if(state.bonusZapCd<=0){
        const p=state.player;
        let target=null,best=170;
        for(const o of state.obstacles){
          if(o.type==='boss') continue;
          const d=Math.hypot(o.x-p.x,o.y-p.y);
          if(d<best){best=d;target=o;}
        }
        if(target){
          const tx=target.x, ty=target.y;
          target.x=-999; target.bonusZapped=true; state.bonusZapCd=.85; state.flash=Math.max(state.flash,.18); addBonusPoints(12);
          for(let i=0;i<12;i++) state.sparks.push({x:tx+rand(-20,20),y:ty+rand(-20,20),r:rand(2,5),life:rand(.14,.28)});
          for(let i=0;i<10;i++) state.particles.push({x:p.x+rand(-20,20),y:p.y+rand(-26,12),vx:rand(-90,90),vy:rand(-70,50),r:rand(2,5),life:rand(.18,.4),type:'bonus',bonusType:'foudre'});
        } else state.bonusZapCd=.22;
      }
    }
    if(state.bonusTimer<=0) deactivateFeatherBonus();
  }

  function capsulePath(x,y,w,h,r=Math.min(h/2,22)){
    r=Math.min(r,w/2,h/2);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
    ctx.lineTo(x+w-r,y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r);
    ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h);
    ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r);
    ctx.lineTo(x,y+r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);
    ctx.closePath();
  }
  function updateBonusVisuals(dt){
    state.bonusPulse = Math.max(0, state.bonusPulse - dt*1.2);
    if(state.bonusBurst){
      state.bonusBurst.time += dt;
      state.bonusBurst.life -= dt;
      if(state.bonusBurst.life<=0) state.bonusBurst=null;
    }
    for(const r of state.ribbons){
      r.x += r.vx*dt;
      r.y += r.vy*dt;
      r.vy += 40*dt;
      r.rot += r.vr*dt;
      r.life -= dt*1.15;
    }
    state.ribbons = state.ribbons.filter(r=>r.life>0);
  }
  function drawBonusVisuals(){
    if(state.bonusType && state.player){
      const p=state.player, color=bonusColor(state.bonusType), pulse=state.bonusPulse;
      const glowAlpha=.045 + pulse*.06 + (Math.sin(state.time*6)+1)*.01;
      ctx.save();
      const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x,p.y,26,p.x,p.y,330);
      g.addColorStop(0,color+'55'); g.addColorStop(.38,color+'1a'); g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
      ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(.18,glowAlpha);
      ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    for(const r of state.ribbons){
      const a=Math.max(0,r.life);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(r.x,r.y);
      ctx.rotate(r.rot);
      ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(.9,a);
      const c=bonusColor(r.bonusType);
      const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(-r.len/2,0,r.len/2,0);
      grad.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
      grad.addColorStop(.18,c+'dd');
      grad.addColorStop(.82,'rgba(255,255,255,.92)');
      grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle=grad;
      ctx.shadowColor=c; ctx.shadowBlur=10;
      capsulePath(-r.len/2,-r.w/2,r.len,r.w,r.w/2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
    if(state.bonusBurst && state.player){
      const b=state.bonusBurst, p=state.player, color=bonusColor(b.type);
      const prog=1-(b.life/1.15), baseY=p.y-92+Math.sin(b.time*9)*2;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, baseY);
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
      for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
        const rad=26 + prog*76 + i*22;
        ctx.strokeStyle=`${color}${i===0?'dd':'88'}`;
        ctx.globalAlpha=(1-prog)*(i===0?.85:.45);
        ctx.lineWidth=i===0?5:2.6;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,rad,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
      }
      for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
        const ang=prog*3+i*(Math.PI*2/10), inner=30+prog*14, outer=52+prog*26;
        ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.8)';
        ctx.globalAlpha=(1-prog)*.65;
        ctx.lineWidth=2.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(ang)*inner, Math.sin(ang)*inner);
        ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(ang)*outer, Math.sin(ang)*outer);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();

      const txt=`BONUS ${b.text.toUpperCase()}`;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.font='900 18px Arial';
      const tw=ctx.measureText(txt).width;
      const padX=18, bx=p.x-(tw+padX*2)/2, by=baseY-22;
      ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,b.life/.3) * Math.max(.15,1-prog*.25);
      ctx.shadowColor=color; ctx.shadowBlur=18;
      const panel=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,by,0,by+38);
      panel.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.98)');
      panel.addColorStop(1,'rgba(242,250,255,.92)');
      ctx.fillStyle=panel; capsulePath(bx,by,tw+padX*2,38,19); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle=color; ctx.lineWidth=2.2; ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle='#18486f'; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
      ctx.fillText(txt,p.x,by+20);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawFeatherBonusPlayer(){
    const type=state.bonusType, p=state.player;
    if(!type||!p) return false;
    const img=FEATHER_BONUS_ASSETS[type]?.player;
    if(!img||!img.complete||!img.naturalWidth) return false;
    const color=bonusColor(type);
    const t=state.time;
    const pulse=1+Math.sin(t*8)*.028;
    const hover=Math.sin(t*7.3)*4.5;
    const lean=(p.hit?p.rot+p.deadRot:p.rot)*.34 + Math.sin(t*4.4)*.03;
    const squish=Math.sin(t*9.2)*.015;
    const targetW=(type==='foudre'?205:type==='rafale'?198:194)*pulse;
    const sc=targetW/img.naturalWidth, dw=img.naturalWidth*sc, dh=img.naturalHeight*sc;
    const cx=p.x, cy=p.y+Math.sin(p.bob)*2.5-6+hover;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx,cy);
    ctx.rotate(lean);
    ctx.scale(1+squish,1-squish*.6);

    const glow=ctx.createRadialGradient(0,-6,10,0,0,102);
    glow.addColorStop(0,color+'cc');
    glow.addColorStop(.45,color+'55');
    glow.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    ctx.globalAlpha=.45;
    ctx.fillStyle=glow;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,2,92,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;

    if(type==='bouclier'){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.rotate(t*1.6);
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,240,170,.95)';
      ctx.lineWidth=5;
      ctx.shadowColor='rgba(255,220,100,.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur=12;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,10,64+Math.sin(t*5)*3,58+Math.cos(t*4.4)*3,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha=.45;
      ctx.lineWidth=2.4;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,10,76,69,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    } else if(type==='aimant'){
      ctx.save();
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
        const a=t*2.8+i*Math.PI/2;
        const ox=Math.cos(a)*56, oy=Math.sin(a)*22;
        ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(127,240,255,.7)';
        ctx.lineWidth=2.2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ox*.52,oy*.52); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ox*.18,-16,ox,oy); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.95)'; ctx.shadowColor='rgba(49,217,255,.95)'; ctx.shadowBlur=10;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ox,oy,5.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    } else if(type==='rafale'){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(-44,8);
      for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
        ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,${165+i*18},90,${0.82-i*0.18})`;
        ctx.lineWidth=4.4-i*.9;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-34-i*10,12+i*8);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(6,-2-i*7,46-i*4,-16+i*6);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    } else if(type==='foudre'){
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(203,183,255,.96)';
      ctx.lineWidth=3.4;
      ctx.shadowColor='rgba(139,108,255,.98)'; ctx.shadowBlur=14;
      for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
        const a=t*4.5+i*2.1;
        const bx=Math.cos(a)*48, by=Math.sin(a*1.2)*34;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(bx-8,by-22);
        ctx.lineTo(bx+5,by-6);
        ctx.lineTo(bx-2,by+3);
        ctx.lineTo(bx+10,by+24);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }

    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor=color; ctx.shadowBlur=26; ctx.globalAlpha=.985;
    ctx.drawImage(img,-dw*.5,-dh*.53,dw,dh);
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
      const a=t*3+i*(Math.PI*2/3);
      const rx=Math.cos(a)*(type==='bouclier'?56:46), ry=Math.sin(a*1.15)*(type==='bouclier'?22:18)-8;
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.55)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(rx,ry,3.2+i*.45,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
    return true;
  }
  function showToast(text){
    const el = document.getElementById('toast');
    el.textContent = text; el.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(showToast._t);
    showToast._t = setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'), 1800);
  }
  function setScreen(name){
    Object.values(screens).forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
    hud.classList.remove('active');
    if(name==='play'){ hud.classList.add('active'); }
    else if(screens[name]) screens[name].classList.add('active');
    state.screen = name;
  }

  function levelTheme(idx){ return LEVELS[idx] || LEVELS[0]; }

  function createPlayer(){
    return {
      x: 150, y: 420, vy: 0, r: 25, rot: 0,
      blinkTimer: rand(1.7,3.4), blink:0,
      wink: 0, mood:'happy', cheer:0, bob:0,
      umbrellaTilt:0, hit:false, deadRot:0,
    };
  }

  function initBackground(themeName){
    state.farClouds = Array.from({length:7},()=>({x:rand(0,W),y:rand(60,H-140),s:rand(.5,1.25),spd:rand(8,16),a:rand(.18,.42)}));
    state.midClouds = Array.from({length:8},()=>({x:rand(0,W),y:rand(80,H-100),s:rand(.8,1.45),spd:rand(18,34),a:rand(.28,.58)}));
    state.nearClouds = Array.from({length:5},()=>({x:rand(0,W),y:rand(120,H-120),s:rand(1.0,1.8),spd:rand(28,48),a:rand(.35,.7)}));
    state.farIslands = Array.from({length:8},()=>({x:rand(0,W+180),y:rand(160,H-260),s:rand(.24,.45),spd:rand(10,18),seed:Math.random()}));
    state.nearIslands = Array.from({length:4},()=>({x:rand(0,W+260),y:rand(280,H-130),s:rand(.52,.98),spd:rand(38,65),seed:Math.random()}));
    state.windLines = Array.from({length:10},()=>({x:rand(0,W),y:rand(100,H-80),len:rand(35,110),spd:rand(100,190),a:rand(.08,.24)}));
    state.starscape = Array.from({length:70},()=>({x:rand(0,W),y:rand(0,H),r:rand(1,2.8),tw:rand(0,6.28)}));
    state.moonGlow = rand(0,1);
  }

  function resetLevel(index, mode='adventure'){
    state.mode = mode;
    state.levelIndex = index;
    state.running = true;
    state.paused = false;
    state.score = 0;
    state.progress = 0;
    state.time = 0;
    state.nearMiss = 0;
    state.lives = state.difficulty==='easy' ? 2 : 1;
    state.invuln = 0;
    state.collected = 0;
    state.featherCount = 0;
    state.bonusType = null;
    state.bonusTimer = 0;
    state.bonusShieldHits = 0;
    state.bonusZapCd = 0;
    state.bonusLast = null;
    state.bonusScore = 0;
    state.obstacles = [];
    state.collectibles = [];
    state.particles = [];
    state.sparks = [];
    state.ribbons = [];
    state.bonusPulse = 0;
    state.bonusBurst = null;
    state.player = createPlayer();
    state.flash = 0;
    state.heroSpin = 0;
    state.bossSpawned = false;
    initBackground(levelTheme(index).theme);
    state.spawnObstacle = index===0 && mode==='adventure' ? 1.65 : .85;
    state.spawnCollect = index===0 && mode==='adventure' ? .85 : 1.4;
    updateHUD();
    setScreen('play');
  }

  function resetEndless(){
    resetLevel(0, 'endless');
  }

  function updateHUD(){
    const level = state.mode==='endless' ? {name:'Mode infini', duration:999, starGoal:999} : levelTheme(state.levelIndex);
    document.getElementById('scoreText').textContent = fmt(state.score);
    document.getElementById('levelName').textContent = state.mode==='endless' ? 'Mode infini' : `Niveau ${level.id} • ${level.name}`;
    const pct = state.mode==='endless' ? Math.min(100,(state.score%50)*2) : Math.min(100,Math.floor((state.progress/level.duration)*100));
    document.getElementById('progressLabel').textContent = state.mode==='endless' ? `${state.score} pts` : `${pct}%`;
    document.getElementById('progressFill').style.width = `${pct}%`;
    document.getElementById('starCount').textContent = state.mode==='endless' ? state.collected : Math.min(state.collected, level.starGoal);
    document.getElementById('starGoal').textContent = state.mode==='endless' ? '∞' : level.starGoal;
    const featherEl=document.getElementById('featherCount'); if(featherEl) featherEl.textContent=state.featherCount;
    const bonusHud=document.getElementById('bonusHud'), bonusIcon=document.getElementById('bonusHudIcon'), bonusTimer=document.getElementById('bonusHudTimer');
    if(bonusHud && state.bonusType){ bonusHud.classList.add('show'); if(bonusIcon) bonusIcon.src=FEATHER_BONUS_ASSET_SRC[state.bonusType].icon; if(bonusTimer) bonusTimer.textContent=`${Math.ceil(state.bonusTimer)}s`; }
    else if(bonusHud){ bonusHud.classList.remove('show'); }
    const lifeHud=document.getElementById('lifeHud');
    if(lifeHud){
      if(state.difficulty==='easy'){lifeHud.classList.add('show');lifeHud.textContent=state.lives>=2?'❤️❤️':state.lives===1?'❤️🖤':'🖤🖤';}
      else lifeHud.classList.remove('show');
    }
    const nearCountEl = document.getElementById('nearCount'); if(nearCountEl) nearCountEl.textContent = state.nearMiss;
  }

    2:['sepia(.82) saturate(3.2) hue-rotate(345deg) brightness(.90)','sepia(.85) saturate(4.4) hue-rotate(280deg) brightness(.82)','sepia(.62) saturate(3.0) hue-rotate(15deg) brightness(.84)','sepia(.55) saturate(2.2) hue-rotate(180deg) brightness(.90)'],
    3:['brightness(.76) saturate(1.35)','sepia(.75) saturate(3.8) hue-rotate(220deg) brightness(.70)','sepia(.8) saturate(2.8) hue-rotate(335deg) brightness(.72)','grayscale(.25) brightness(.72) contrast(1.12)'],
    4:['sepia(.75) saturate(3.6) hue-rotate(205deg) brightness(.68) contrast(1.18)','sepia(.8) saturate(4.3) hue-rotate(245deg) brightness(.72)','grayscale(.25) sepia(.55) saturate(3) hue-rotate(185deg) brightness(.72)','sepia(.82) saturate(3.8) hue-rotate(290deg) brightness(.67)'],
    5:['sepia(.52) saturate(2.4) hue-rotate(175deg) brightness(.83) contrast(1.12)','sepia(.72) saturate(3.4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(.78)','grayscale(.28) sepia(.38) saturate(2.1) hue-rotate(160deg) brightness(.88)','sepia(.62) saturate(3.0) hue-rotate(265deg) brightness(.82)'],
    6:['brightness(1.30) saturate(.42) hue-rotate(155deg)','brightness(1.16) saturate(.62) hue-rotate(175deg)','brightness(1.40) saturate(.28) contrast(1.05)','sepia(.18) saturate(.72) hue-rotate(160deg) brightness(1.22)'],
    7:['sepia(.22) saturate(2.2) hue-rotate(125deg) brightness(1.12)','sepia(.38) saturate(3.0) hue-rotate(165deg) brightness(1.04)','brightness(1.18) saturate(.82) hue-rotate(115deg)','sepia(.20) saturate(2.4) hue-rotate(200deg) brightness(1.12)'],
    8:['sepia(.50) saturate(3.1) hue-rotate(215deg) brightness(.92)','sepia(.36) saturate(3.6) hue-rotate(250deg) brightness(.88)','grayscale(.12) saturate(1.8) hue-rotate(205deg) brightness(.90)','sepia(.48) saturate(2.7) hue-rotate(285deg) brightness(.90)'],
    9:['sepia(.58) saturate(4.0) hue-rotate(285deg) brightness(.82) contrast(1.14)','sepia(.62) saturate(4.2) hue-rotate(315deg) brightness(.80)','grayscale(.25) sepia(.55) saturate(3.4) hue-rotate(245deg) brightness(.82)','sepia(.70) saturate(4.5) hue-rotate(335deg) brightness(.84)']
  };
  function drawAdventureBirdAnimated(o){
    const frames=HD_L1_RECTS.birds;
    const frame=Math.abs(Math.floor((o.phase%(Math.PI*2))/(Math.PI/2)))%frames.length;
    const scale=o.type==='birdfast'?.15:o.type==='owl'?.145:.16;
    const rot=Math.sin(o.phase)*.08;
    ctx.save();
    if(state.levelIndex>=1&&state.levelIndex<=9){const fs=BIRD_FILTERS_BY_LEVEL[state.levelIndex]||[];ctx.filter=fs[(o.variant||0)%Math.max(1,fs.length)]||'none';}
    ctx.shadowColor='rgba(20,48,86,.18)';ctx.shadowBlur=10;ctx.shadowOffsetY=4;
    drawSpriteCenter(HD_L1.birds,frames[frame],o.x,o.y,scale,rot,1,true,.5,.5);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function spawnBird(theme){
    const kinds=['bird','birdfast','owl'];
    const type=theme.theme==='night'||theme.theme==='aurora'?(Math.random()<.4?'owl':'bird'):kinds[Math.floor(Math.random()*2)];
    const y=rand(170,H-220);
    const speed=levelTheme(state.levelIndex).speed+(type==='birdfast'?46:type==='owl'?12:24);
    const core=state.mode!=='endless';
    state.obstacles.push({
      type,x:W+90,y,vx:speed,r:core?22:(type==='owl'?32:26),phase:rand(0,6.2),amp:rand(10,24),warned:false,passed:false,near:false,
      variant:(state.mode!=='endless'&&state.levelIndex>=1)?Math.floor(Math.random()*4):0
    });
  }
  function spawnStorm(theme){
    const level=levelTheme(state.levelIndex);
    const ratio=state.mode==='endless'?0:clamp(state.progress/level.duration,0,1);
    const y=rand(level.id===3?220:200,H-((level.id===4||level.id===5)?300:320));
    const big=theme.theme==='boss'||(level.id===4&&Math.random()<.28)||(level.id===5&&Math.random()<.36);
    const gentle=level.id===3&&ratio<.48;
    state.obstacles.push({
      type:'storm',x:W+110,y,vx:level.speed+(level.id===5?18:(level.id===4?12:8)),
      r:level.id===3?40:(level.id===4?(big?50:44):(level.id===5?(big?52:44):(big?50:40))),phase:rand(0,6.2),warn:0,bolt:0,
      flashCd:gentle?99:(level.id===5?rand(.95,1.8):(level.id===4?rand(1.25,2.4):rand(1.8,3.2))),
      boltLen:level.id===3?rand(125,190):(level.id===4?rand(155,245):(level.id===5?rand(175,270):(big?rand(180,300):rand(130,240)))),
      passed:false,near:false,big,canBolt:!gentle,
      variant:level.id===3?Math.floor(Math.random()*HD_L3_RECTS.storms.length):((level.id===4||level.id===5)?Math.floor(Math.random()*HD_L4_RECTS.storms.length):0)
    });
  }
  function spawnBoss(){
    state.obstacles.push({ type:'boss', x:W+160, y:H*0.34, vx:195, r:74, phase:0, warn:0, bolt:0, flashCd:1.6, boltLen:300, hp:999, passed:false, near:false });
  }

  function spawnCollectible(){
    // Collectibles are intentionally identical across every level:
    // HD stars + the same feather used since level 1. No sun collectible.
    const type = Math.random() < .66 ? 'star' : 'feather';
    state.collectibles.push({ x: W+60, y: rand(160, H-220), r: type==='star'?16:15, type, vx: levelTheme(state.levelIndex).speed - 10, phase: rand(0,6.2)});
  }

  function flap(){
    if(!state.running || state.paused) return;
    state.player.vy = state.bonusType==='rafale' ? -370 : -315;
    state.player.rot = state.bonusType==='rafale' ? -.34 : -.28;
    state.player.cheer = .18;
    for(let i=0;i<8;i++) state.particles.push({x:state.player.x-34+rand(-4,4),y:state.player.y+rand(-12,12),vx:rand(-110,-30),vy:rand(-40,40),r:rand(4,10),life:1,type:'puff'});
  }

  function endGame(){
    state.running = false;
    state.player.hit = true;
    document.getElementById('deadScore').textContent = fmt(state.score);
    const pct = state.mode==='endless' ? `${state.score} pts` : `${Math.floor((state.progress/levelTheme(state.levelIndex).duration)*100)}%`;
    document.getElementById('deadDist').textContent = pct;
    if(state.mode==='endless'){
      if(state.score > state.bestEndless){
        state.bestEndless = state.score;
        state.progressData.bestEndless = state.bestEndless;
      }
    } else {
      const lv=levelTheme(state.levelIndex);
      const entry=state.progressData.levels[lv.id] || {best:0,stars:0,collected:0,completed:false};
      entry.best=Math.max(Number(entry.best||0),state.score);
      state.progressData.levels[lv.id]=entry;
      state.progressData.lastLevel=state.levelIndex;
    }
    saveProgress();
    refreshHomeScore();
    setScreen('over');
  }

  function completeLevel(){
    state.running = false;
    const level = levelTheme(state.levelIndex);
    const stars = state.collected >= level.starGoal ? 3 : state.collected >= Math.ceil(level.starGoal*0.72) ? 2 : 1;
    const entry = state.progressData.levels[level.id] || {best:0,stars:0,collected:0,completed:false};
    entry.best = Math.max(entry.best, state.score);
    entry.stars = Math.max(entry.stars, stars);
    entry.collected = Math.max(entry.collected, state.collected);
    entry.completed = true;
    state.progressData.levels[level.id] = entry;
    let unlockedNew = null;
    if(!TEST_ALL_LEVELS && state.progressData.unlocked < level.id + 1 && level.id < LEVELS.length){
      state.progressData.unlocked = level.id + 1;
      unlockedNew = level.id + 1;
    }
    saveProgress();

    document.getElementById('finalScore').textContent = fmt(state.score);
    document.getElementById('finalBest').textContent = fmt(entry.best);
    document.getElementById('finalCollect').textContent = `${Math.min(state.collected,level.starGoal)}/${level.starGoal}`;
    document.getElementById('finalNear').textContent = state.nearMiss;
    document.getElementById('resultStars').innerHTML = Array.from({length:3},(_,i)=>`<span class="${i<stars?'star-on':'star-off'}">★</span>`).join('');
    document.getElementById('nextLevelBtn').style.display = level.id < LEVELS.length ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
    setScreen('complete');

    if(unlockedNew){
      state.justUnlocked = unlockedNew;
    } else {
      state.justUnlocked = null;
    }
  }

  function maybeShowUnlock(){
    if(TEST_ALL_LEVELS) return false;
    if(!state.justUnlocked) return false;
    const lv = LEVELS[state.justUnlocked-1];
    document.getElementById('unlockedName').textContent = `Chapitre ${lv.id} • ${lv.name}`;
    document.getElementById('unlockedDesc').textContent = lv.desc;
    state.justUnlocked = null;
    setScreen('unlocked');
    return true;
  }

  function collisionCircle(a,b){
    const dx=a.x-b.x, dy=a.y-b.y, rr = a.r+b.r;
    return dx*dx+dy*dy < rr*rr*0.72;
  }
  function collectibleCollision(player,c){
    const extra = c.type==='feather' ? 18 : c.type==='star' ? 11 : 10;
    const rr = player.r + c.r + extra;
    const dx = Math.abs(player.x-c.x), dy = Math.abs(player.y-c.y);
    if(dx < rr*0.92 && dy < rr*0.82) return true;
    return (player.x-c.x)*(player.x-c.x) + (player.y-c.y)*(player.y-c.y) < rr*rr;
  }
  function collisionBolt(player, obs){
    if(!(obs.type==='storm' || obs.type==='boss') || obs.bolt<=0) return false;
    const left = obs.x-6, right = obs.x+6, top = obs.y+obs.r*0.45, bottom = obs.y+obs.boltLen;
    return player.x+player.r > left && player.x-player.r < right && player.y+player.r > top && player.y-player.r < bottom;
  }

  function stormChanceForLevel(level){
    const ratio=state.mode==='endless'?0:clamp(state.progress/level.duration,0,1);
    if(level.id===2)return 0;
    if(level.id===3){if(ratio<.18)return 0;if(ratio<.40)return .06;if(ratio<.65)return .13;if(ratio<.82)return .22;return .32;}
    if(level.id===4){if(ratio<.15)return .16;if(ratio<.40)return .26;if(ratio<.65)return .36;if(ratio<.85)return .46;return .56;}
    if(level.id===5){if(ratio<.12)return .28;if(ratio<.35)return .40;if(ratio<.62)return .50;if(ratio<.82)return .58;return .66;}
    return level.stormRate;
  }

  function update(dt){
    const level = levelTheme(state.levelIndex);
    const theme = level.theme;

    const bgMul = (state.running && !state.paused) ? 1 : .22;
    [...state.farClouds, ...state.midClouds, ...state.nearClouds].forEach(c => {
      c.x -= c.spd * dt * bgMul;
      if(c.x < -180) { c.x = W + rand(40,180); c.y = rand(60, H-120); }
    });
    [...state.farIslands, ...state.nearIslands].forEach(i => {
      i.x -= i.spd * dt * bgMul;
      if(i.x < -180) { i.x = W + rand(80,220); i.y = rand(i.s>.6?260:160, H-(i.s>.6?130:260)); i.seed = Math.random(); }
    });
    state.windLines.forEach(w=>{ w.x -= w.spd*dt*bgMul; if(w.x < -150){w.x=W+rand(40,140);w.y=rand(100,H-80);} });
    state.starscape.forEach(s=>s.tw += dt*2.5);

    if(!state.running || state.paused) return;

    state.time += dt;
    state.progress += dt;
    state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt*2.4);
    state.invuln = Math.max(0, state.invuln - dt);
    updateFeatherBonus(dt);
    updateBonusVisuals(dt);

    const p = state.player;
    p.bob += dt*5.5;
    p.blinkTimer -= dt;
    if(p.blinkTimer<=0 && p.blink<=0){ p.blink=.12; p.blinkTimer = rand(1.8,3.4); }
    if(p.blink>0) p.blink -= dt;
    if(p.wink>0) p.wink -= dt;
    p.cheer = Math.max(0,p.cheer-dt);

    p.vy += (state.bonusType==='rafale' ? 445 : 530) * dt;
    p.y += p.vy*dt;
    const tRot = clamp(p.vy/520,-.28,.58);
    p.rot += (tRot - p.rot) * Math.min(1, dt*7);
    p.umbrellaTilt = Math.sin(state.time*4)*0.05 + (p.mood==='panic'?0.08:0);

    if(state.mode==='endless'){
      if(Math.floor(state.progress*4)!==Math.floor((state.progress-dt)*4)) state.score += 1;
    } else {
      state.score = Math.floor(state.progress * 10) + state.bonusScore;
    }

    state.spawnObstacle -= dt;
    state.spawnCollect -= dt;

    if(level.id===10 && state.mode!=='endless' && state.progress > 10 && !state.bossSpawned){
      spawnBoss(); state.bossSpawned=true;
    }

    const ratio=state.mode==='endless'?0:clamp(state.progress/level.duration,0,1);
    const obGap=state.mode==='endless'?Math.max(.62,1.12-state.score*0.0015):Math.max(.7,1.2-level.id*0.03);
    if(state.spawnObstacle<=0){
      let useStorm=Math.random()<stormChanceForLevel(level);
      if(level.id===1&&state.mode!=='endless'&&state.progress<15)useStorm=false;
      if(level.id===2&&state.mode!=='endless')useStorm=false;
      if(useStorm&&state.obstacles.some(o=>(o.type==='storm'||o.type==='boss')&&o.x>W*.58))useStorm=false;
      if(useStorm)spawnStorm(level);else spawnBird(level);
      if(state.mode!=='endless'&&level.id===1)state.spawnObstacle=rand(1.16,1.48);
      else if(state.mode!=='endless'&&level.id===2)state.spawnObstacle=rand(1.04,1.28);
      else if(state.mode!=='endless'&&level.id===3)state.spawnObstacle=Math.max(.86,1.12-ratio*.18)+rand(-.05,.10);
      else if(state.mode!=='endless'&&level.id===4)state.spawnObstacle=Math.max(.74,1.02-ratio*.18)+rand(-.05,.08);
      else state.spawnObstacle=obGap+rand(-.08,.18);
    }
    if(state.spawnCollect<=0){
      spawnCollectible();
      state.spawnCollect = rand(1.2,1.9);
    }

    let nearest = 999;

    for(const o of state.obstacles){
      o.x -= o.vx*dt*(state.bonusType==='rafale'?.84:1);
      o.phase += dt*(o.type==='owl'?5.2:o.type==='boss'?2.1:7.5);
      if(o.type==='bird' || o.type==='birdfast' || o.type==='owl'){
        o.y += Math.sin(o.phase) * o.amp * dt * (o.type==='birdfast'?1.5:1);
      }
      if(o.type==='storm' || o.type==='boss'){
        o.y += Math.sin(o.phase) * 16 * dt;
        if(o.canBolt===false){o.warn=0;o.bolt=0;}
        else if(o.warn<=0 && o.bolt<=0){
          o.flashCd -= dt;
          if(o.flashCd<=0){ o.warn=.55; o.flashCd=(state.levelIndex===3?rand(1.25,2.45):rand(1.5,3.2)); }
        } else if(o.warn>0){
          o.warn -= dt;
          if(o.warn<=0){ o.bolt=(theme==='deepstorm'||o.type==='boss'||state.levelIndex===3)?.58:.42; state.flash=state.levelIndex===4?.38:(state.levelIndex===3?.30:.24); }
        } else if(o.bolt>0){
          o.bolt -= dt;
          for(let i=0;i<3;i++) state.sparks.push({x:o.x+rand(-6,6),y:o.y+rand(20,o.boltLen),r:rand(2,5),life:rand(.12,.22)});
        }
      }
      if(o.x >= p.x) nearest = Math.min(nearest, o.x-p.x);
      if(!o.near && Math.abs(o.x-p.x) < 68 && Math.abs(o.y-p.y) < 80 && !collisionCircle(p,o) && !collisionBolt(p,o)){
        o.near = true; state.nearMiss += 1;
        if(state.nearMiss % 3 === 0) p.wink = .5;
        showToast('Ennemi frôlé !');
      }
      if((collisionCircle(p,o) || collisionBolt(p,o)) && state.invuln<=0){
        if(state.bonusType==='bouclier' && state.bonusShieldHits>0){
          state.bonusShieldHits=0; state.bonusTimer=0; state.flash=Math.max(state.flash,.28); if(o.type==='boss'){o.x+=140;o.warn=0;o.bolt=0;}else{o.x=-999;}
          for(let i=0;i<14;i++) state.particles.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,vx:rand(-120,120),vy:rand(-120,120),r:rand(3,8),life:1,type:'bonus'});
          showToast('Bouclier : choc absorbé !'); deactivateFeatherBonus(); continue;
        }
        if(state.difficulty==='easy' && state.lives>1){
          state.lives-=1; state.invuln=1.35; state.flash=Math.max(state.flash,.24); if(o.type==='boss'){o.x+=140;o.warn=0;o.bolt=0;}else{o.x=-999;} p.vy=-170; p.wink=.7;
          for(let i=0;i<16;i++) state.particles.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,vx:rand(-140,140),vy:rand(-140,80),r:rand(3,8),life:1,type:'puff'});
          showToast('Touché ! Il reste 1 chance'); updateHUD(); continue;
        }
        return endGame();
      }
    }
    state.obstacles = state.obstacles.filter(o=>o.x > -220);

    for(const c of state.collectibles){
      c.x -= c.vx*dt; c.phase += dt*5.5; c.y += Math.sin(c.phase)*18*dt;
      const dx=p.x-c.x, dy=p.y-c.y, d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
      if(c.type==='feather' && d<92 && d>3){
        const pull=(1-d/92)*260+72;
        c.x += dx/d*pull*dt; c.y += dy/d*pull*dt;
      }
      if(state.bonusType==='aimant' && d<185 && d>4){
        const pull=(1-d/185)*360+85;
        c.x += dx/d*pull*dt; c.y += dy/d*pull*dt;
      }
      if(collectibleCollision(p, c)){
        if(c.type==='feather'){
          state.featherCount += 1;
          if(state.featherCount>=4) activateRandomFeatherBonus();
        } else {
          state.collected += 1;
        }
        for(let i=0;i<10;i++) state.particles.push({x:c.x,y:c.y,vx:rand(-78,78),vy:rand(-78,78),r:rand(4,8),life:1,type:c.type});
        c.hit = true;
      }
    }
    state.collectibles = state.collectibles.filter(c=>!c.hit && c.x > -80);

    for(const par of state.particles){
      par.x += par.vx*dt; par.y += par.vy*dt; par.vy += 60*dt; par.life -= dt*1.5;
    }
    state.particles = state.particles.filter(p=>p.life>0);
    state.sparks.forEach(s=>{ s.life -= dt; });
    state.sparks = state.sparks.filter(s=>s.life>0);

    p.mood = p.hit ? 'dead' : nearest<82 ? 'panic' : nearest<145 ? 'worried' : Math.abs(p.vy)<30 ? 'joy' : 'happy';

    if(p.y < 110 || p.y > H-118) return endGame();

    if(state.mode!=='endless' && state.progress >= level.duration){
      completeLevel();
    }
    updateHUD();
  }

  function skyGradient(theme){
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    switch(theme){
      case 'sunset': g.addColorStop(0,'#ffaf64'); g.addColorStop(.45,'#ff7f88'); g.addColorStop(1,'#715cff'); break;
      case 'storm': g.addColorStop(0,'#385b88'); g.addColorStop(.5,'#27496b'); g.addColorStop(1,'#1b3554'); break;
      case 'deepstorm': g.addColorStop(0,'#1b3557'); g.addColorStop(.45,'#142b46'); g.addColorStop(1,'#102437'); break;
      case 'night': g.addColorStop(0,'#152d64'); g.addColorStop(.5,'#1f376d'); g.addColorStop(1,'#284483'); break;
      case 'snow': g.addColorStop(0,'#8ed2ff'); g.addColorStop(.45,'#a3e5ff'); g.addColorStop(1,'#ebfbff'); break;
      case 'aurora': g.addColorStop(0,'#142964'); g.addColorStop(.45,'#1a387a'); g.addColorStop(1,'#1f6288'); break;
      case 'vortex': g.addColorStop(0,'#172750'); g.addColorStop(.45,'#3a215f'); g.addColorStop(1,'#141f4f'); break;
      case 'boss': g.addColorStop(0,'#231b47'); g.addColorStop(.4,'#4a1f43'); g.addColorStop(1,'#251e5f'); break;
      case 'garden': g.addColorStop(0,'#68cfff'); g.addColorStop(.48,'#93e5ff'); g.addColorStop(1,'#dff9ff'); break;
      default: g.addColorStop(0,'#60c8ff'); g.addColorStop(.48,'#9be7ff'); g.addColorStop(1,'#edfcff'); break;
    }
    return g;
  }

  function drawBg(theme){
    if(isLevel1HD() && level1AssetsReady()){ drawLevel1BackdropHD(); return; }
    if(isLevel2HD() && level2AssetsReady()){ drawLevel2BackdropHD(); return; }
    if(isLevel3HD() && level3AssetsReady()){ drawLevel3BackdropHD(); return; }
    if(isLevel4HD() && level4AssetsReady()){ drawLevel4BackdropHD(); return; }
    if(isLevel5HD() && level5AssetsReady()){ drawLevel5BackdropHD(); return; }
    if(isLevel6HD() && level6AssetsReady()){ drawLevel6BackdropHD(); return; }
    if(isLevel7HD() && level7AssetsReady()){ drawLevel7BackdropHD(); return; }
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle = skyGradient(theme);
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    drawThemeBackdrop(theme);

    if(['night','aurora','vortex','boss'].includes(theme)){
      for(const s of state.starscape){
        const a = .35 + Math.sin(s.tw)*.25;
        ctx.globalAlpha = a;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      if(theme==='night' || theme==='aurora'){
        const moonX=440, moonY=130; const rad=44;
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,248,201,.9)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(moonX,moonY,rad,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = skyGradient(theme); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(moonX+16, moonY-10, rad-10, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      }
    } else {
      const sun = ctx.createRadialGradient(440,160,10,440,160,90);
      sun.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,226,.98)'); sun.addColorStop(.35,'rgba(255,241,149,.72)'); sun.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,241,149,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = sun; ctx.fillRect(330,50,220,220);
    }

    if(theme==='aurora' || theme==='vortex'){
      ctx.strokeStyle = theme==='aurora' ? 'rgba(80,255,202,.26)' : 'rgba(210,116,255,.22)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 26;
      for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-30,170+i*70);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(120,80+i*35, 280,240+i*25, 580,110+i*62);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.lineWidth = 14;
      ctx.strokeStyle = theme==='aurora' ? 'rgba(102,214,255,.18)' : 'rgba(105,170,255,.16)';
      for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-10,180+i*85);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(150,120, 280,250, 560,160+i*70);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    if(theme==='storm' || theme==='deepstorm' || theme==='boss' || state.flash>0){
      const alpha = theme==='boss' ? .18 : .12;
      for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(180,226,255,${alpha})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        const x = (i*34 + state.time*160) % (W+80) - 40;
        const y = ((i*70)%H);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,y); ctx.lineTo(x-12,y+44); ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    if(state.flash>0){
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${state.flash*.28})`;
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    }

    drawCloudLayer(state.farClouds, theme, .8);
    state.farIslands.forEach(i=>drawIsland(i, theme, true));
    drawCloudLayer(state.midClouds, theme, 1);
    state.nearIslands.forEach(i=>drawIsland(i, theme, false));
    drawWind();
    drawCloudLayer(state.nearClouds, theme, 1.24);

    drawBottomFog();
  }

  function drawCloudLayer(arr, theme, scaleMul){
    for(const c of arr){ drawCloud(c.x,c.y,c.s*scaleMul,c.a, ['storm','deepstorm','boss'].includes(theme)); }
  }

  function drawCloud(x,y,s,a,dark){
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.scale(s,s); ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,-34,0,32);
    if(dark){ g.addColorStop(0,'#5b7197'); g.addColorStop(.55,'#394d71'); g.addColorStop(1,'#243652'); }
    else { g.addColorStop(0,'#ffffff'); g.addColorStop(.56,'#edf8ff'); g.addColorStop(1,'#c2e5fb'); }
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.shadowColor = dark ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.18)' : 'rgba(36,126,193,.15)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-38,5,24,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(-10,-12,34,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(24,-1,29,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(50,10,18,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.arc(6,14,35,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawIsland(i, theme, blur){
    if(isLevel1HD()&&level1AssetsReady()){
      const pick=i.s>.72?0:i.s>.58?(i.seed>.55?4:1):i.s>.38?(i.seed>.5?1:3):(i.seed>.55?2:3);
      const rect=HD_L1_RECTS.islands[pick],scale=(blur?.15:.20)*i.s+(blur?.06:.09),rot=Math.sin((i.seed||0)*12+state.time*.12)*.01;
      ctx.save();ctx.shadowColor='rgba(15,78,132,.18)';ctx.shadowBlur=blur?8:18;drawSpriteCenter(HD_L1.islands,rect,i.x,i.y+(blur?0:10),scale,rot,blur?.52:.98,false,.5,.42);ctx.restore();return;
    }
    if(isLevel2HD()&&level2AssetsReady()){
      const pick=Math.min(HD_L2_RECTS.islands.length-1,Math.floor((i.seed||0)*HD_L2_RECTS.islands.length)),rect=HD_L2_RECTS.islands[pick],scale=(blur?.20:.27)*i.s+(blur?.035:.055);
      ctx.save();ctx.shadowColor='rgba(16,82,118,.18)';ctx.shadowBlur=blur?7:15;drawSpriteCenter(HD_L2.pack,rect,i.x,i.y+8,scale,Math.sin(state.time*.08+(i.seed||0)*8)*.008,blur?.42:.96,false,.5,.44);ctx.restore();return;
    }
    if(isLevel3HD()&&level3AssetsReady()){
      const rect=HD_L3_RECTS.islands[(Math.floor((i.seed||0)*10)+Math.floor(i.s*7))%HD_L3_RECTS.islands.length],sc=(blur?.15:.20)*i.s+(blur?.05:.075);
      drawSpriteCenter(HD_L3.pack,rect,i.x,i.y+(blur?0:8),sc,Math.sin((i.seed||0)*8)*.008,blur?.44:.97,false,.5,.43);return;
    }
    if(isLevel4HD()&&level4AssetsReady()){
      const rect=HD_L4_RECTS.islands[(Math.floor((i.seed||0)*10)+Math.floor(i.s*6))%HD_L4_RECTS.islands.length],sc=(blur?.15:.20)*i.s+(blur?.05:.075);
      drawSpriteCenter(HD_L4.pack,rect,i.x,i.y+(blur?0:8),sc,Math.sin((i.seed||0)*7)*.008,blur?.40:.96,false,.5,.43);return;
    }
    if(isLevel5HD()&&level5AssetsReady()){
      const rect=HD_L4_RECTS.islands[(Math.floor((i.seed||0)*11)+Math.floor(i.s*7))%HD_L4_RECTS.islands.length],sc=(blur?.15:.20)*i.s+(blur?.05:.075);
      ctx.save(); ctx.filter='hue-rotate(18deg) saturate(1.12) brightness(.84) contrast(1.08)';
      drawSpriteCenter(HD_L4.pack,rect,i.x,i.y+(blur?0:8),sc,Math.sin((i.seed||0)*7+state.time*.08)*.009,blur?.36:.94,false,.5,.43); ctx.restore(); return;
    }
    if(isLevel6HD()&&level6AssetsReady()){
      const pick=i.s>.72?0:i.s>.58?(i.seed>.55?4:1):i.s>.38?(i.seed>.5?1:3):(i.seed>.55?2:3);
      const rect=HD_L1_RECTS.islands[pick],sc=(blur?.145:.19)*i.s+(blur?.05:.07);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.filter='hue-rotate(145deg) saturate(.78) brightness(.58) contrast(1.08)';
      ctx.shadowColor='rgba(90,145,255,.18)';ctx.shadowBlur=blur?8:15;
      drawSpriteCenter(HD_L1.islands,rect,i.x,i.y+(blur?0:10),sc,Math.sin((i.seed||0)*7+state.time*.07)*.009,blur?.34:.88,false,.5,.42);
      ctx.restore();return;
    }
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(i.x,i.y); ctx.scale(i.s,i.s);
    ctx.globalAlpha = blur ? .58 : 1;
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(20,80,130,.18)'; ctx.shadowBlur = blur ? 8 : 16;
    const rock = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,120);
    rock.addColorStop(0, theme==='snow' ? '#b7c9d8' : theme==='boss' ? '#6b577d' : '#7b8c9d');
    rock.addColorStop(.48, theme==='snow' ? '#8ea6b7' : theme==='boss' ? '#4f4467' : '#59697c');
    rock.addColorStop(1, theme==='snow' ? '#5e7a8d' : theme==='boss' ? '#352d48' : '#39495c');
    ctx.fillStyle = rock;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-70,10); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-58,64,-18,88); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(10,110,34,78); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(58,48,70,10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    const grass = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,-34,0,20);
    if(theme==='snow'){ grass.addColorStop(0,'#ffffff'); grass.addColorStop(.55,'#f0fbff'); grass.addColorStop(1,'#d2effb'); }
    else if(theme==='boss'){ grass.addColorStop(0,'#ff7a87'); grass.addColorStop(.55,'#8a53e2'); grass.addColorStop(1,'#5f34b0'); }
    else if(theme==='sunset'){ grass.addColorStop(0,'#ffca78'); grass.addColorStop(.48,'#ff965b'); grass.addColorStop(1,'#df5ca8'); }
    else if(theme==='storm' || theme==='deepstorm'){ grass.addColorStop(0,'#7fd55a'); grass.addColorStop(.48,'#48a93a'); grass.addColorStop(1,'#246f2d'); }
    else if(theme==='aurora'){ grass.addColorStop(0,'#91ffe6'); grass.addColorStop(.48,'#2de3be'); grass.addColorStop(1,'#19a5ac'); }
    else if(theme==='vortex'){ grass.addColorStop(0,'#a383ff'); grass.addColorStop(.48,'#6f5ce3'); grass.addColorStop(1,'#4450af'); }
    else { grass.addColorStop(0,'#b7ef48'); grass.addColorStop(.48,'#71d52d'); grass.addColorStop(1,'#1ea43b'); }
    ctx.fillStyle = grass;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-76,10); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-64,-24,-32,-25); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(6,-44,26,-28); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(52,-28,76,-8);
    ctx.lineTo(70,16);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(42,10,34,22); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(12,12,4,22); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-14,10,-24,22); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-46,9,-55,18); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-69,12,-74,18); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

    if(!blur){
      if(theme!=='snow' && theme!=='storm' && theme!=='deepstorm'){
        for(const [dx,dy] of [[-26,-13],[16,-18],[42,-6]]){
          ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx,dy,5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle='#ffd339'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx,dy,2,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        }
      }
      if(theme==='garden'){
        ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.6)'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(10,-8); ctx.lineTo(6,34); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(152,240,255,.65)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(3,8); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(8,22,2,44); ctx.lineTo(14,44); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(18,20,12,6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      }
      if(theme==='sunset'){
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,232,179,.65)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(24,-18,8,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      }
      if(theme==='snow'){
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.95)';
        for(const [dx,dy] of [[-28,-16],[8,-20],[36,-10]]){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(dx,dy,3.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
      }
      if(theme==='aurora'){
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(168,255,243,.85)';
        for(const [dx,dy] of [[-16,-18],[18,-14]]){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx,dy-10); ctx.lineTo(dx+7,dy+4); ctx.lineTo(dx-2,dy+14); ctx.lineTo(dx-8,dy+2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); }
      }
      if(theme==='vortex'){
        ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(184,158,255,.6)'; ctx.lineWidth=2.5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(10,-8,14,0,Math.PI*1.5); ctx.stroke();
      }
      if(theme==='boss'){
        ctx.fillStyle='#ffd453'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(10,-18); ctx.lineTo(18,-40); ctx.lineTo(28,-18); ctx.fill();
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawWind(){
    if(isLevel1HD() && level1AssetsReady()){
      for(let idx=0; idx<state.windLines.length; idx++){
        const w = state.windLines[idx];
        const rect = HD_L1_RECTS.leaves[idx % HD_L1_RECTS.leaves.length];
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(.9, w.a + .15);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.18)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(w.x - 18, w.y + 8); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(w.x + w.len * .4, w.y - 8, w.x + w.len, w.y + 3); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
        drawSpriteCenter(HD_L1.fx, rect, w.x + w.len * .42, w.y, .12 + (idx % 3) * .012, Math.sin(state.time * 2.5 + idx) * .38, Math.min(.95, w.a + .35));
      }
      return;
    }
    if(isLevel2HD() && level2AssetsReady()){
      for(let idx=0; idx<state.windLines.length; idx++){
        const w=state.windLines[idx];
        ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(.75,w.a+.2); ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.17)'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(w.x,w.y); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(w.x+w.len*.45,w.y-12,w.x+w.len,w.y+2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore();
        if(idx%2===0){
          const rect=HD_L2_RECTS.fx[idx%Math.min(2,HD_L2_RECTS.fx.length)];
          drawSpriteCenter(HD_L2.pack,rect,w.x+w.len*.55,w.y,.085,Math.sin(state.time*2+idx)*.35,.72,false,.5,.5);
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    for(const w of state.windLines){
      ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = w.a; ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.2; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(w.x, w.y); ctx.lineTo(w.x + w.len, w.y - 6); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawBottomFog(){
    drawCloud(80, H-25, 2.2, 1, false);
    drawCloud(250, H-10, 2.5, 1, false);
    drawCloud(455, H-24, 2.1, 1, false);
  }

  function drawThemeBackdrop(theme){
    if(theme==='garden'){
      ctx.globalAlpha=.28;
      drawScenicIsland(430,280,1.2,'garden');
      drawScenicIsland(120,215,.72,'garden');
      ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    } else if(theme==='sunset'){
      ctx.globalAlpha=.26;
      drawScenicIsland(428,270,1.08,'sunset');
      ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    } else if(theme==='storm'){
      ctx.globalAlpha=.18;
      drawAngryCloud(430,210,1.2,false);
      ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    } else if(theme==='deepstorm'){
      ctx.globalAlpha=.22;
      drawAngryCloud(420,210,1.35,true);
      ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    } else if(theme==='night'){
      ctx.globalAlpha=.18;
      drawCastleIsland(430,260,.9);
      ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    } else if(theme==='snow'){
      ctx.globalAlpha=.28;
      drawScenicIsland(430,250,1.0,'snow');
      drawSnowflakes();
      ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    } else if(theme==='aurora'){
      ctx.globalAlpha=.26;
      drawScenicIsland(430,260,1.0,'aurora');
      ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    } else if(theme==='vortex'){      drawPortal(440,170,58,'#9a74ff');
    } else if(theme==='boss'){
      ctx.globalAlpha=.16;
      drawAngryCloud(410,180,1.65,true);
      ctx.globalAlpha=1;
      drawPortal(440,170,70,'#ff7bc8');
    }
  }

  function drawScenicIsland(x,y,s,theme){
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.scale(s,s);
    drawIsland({x:0,y:0,s:1,seed:.5}, theme==='garden'?'garden':theme, true);
    if(theme==='garden'){
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';
      ctx.fillRect(-6,-34,4,18); ctx.fillRect(20,-28,4,16);
      ctx.strokeStyle='#a87235'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-4,-30); ctx.lineTo(-14,-20); ctx.moveTo(-4,-30); ctx.lineTo(8,-22); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(22,-24); ctx.lineTo(12,-14); ctx.moveTo(22,-24); ctx.lineTo(32,-16); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(160,240,255,.75)'; ctx.lineWidth=5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-20,2); ctx.lineTo(-26,56); ctx.stroke();
    } else if(theme==='sunset'){
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,241,203,.65)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,-36,18,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    } else if(theme==='snow'){
      ctx.fillStyle='#dff6ff'; ctx.fillRect(-18,-28,12,10); ctx.fillRect(0,-24,13,9);
      ctx.strokeStyle='#8ec7e8'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-12,-18); ctx.lineTo(-12,-28); ctx.moveTo(6,-15); ctx.lineTo(6,-24); ctx.stroke();
    } else if(theme==='aurora'){

      for(const [dx,dy] of [[-10,-24],[18,-18]]){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(dx,dy-12); ctx.lineTo(dx+9,dy+4); ctx.lineTo(dx-2,dy+16); ctx.lineTo(dx-10,dy+2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); }
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawAngryCloud(x,y,s,heavy){
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.scale(s,s);
    const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,-40,0,48); g.addColorStop(0, heavy?'#5d4f8f':'#5b7197'); g.addColorStop(.58, heavy?'#342e64':'#394d71'); g.addColorStop(1, heavy?'#1f203f':'#243652');

    ctx.restore();

  function drawPortal(x,y,r,color){

    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${color==='\#9a74ff'?'154,116,255':'255,123,200'},${.18-i*0.04})`;

  function drawSnowflakes(){
    for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
      const x=(i*31 + state.time*18)%W; const y=((i*57)+state.time*35)%H;
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.34)'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x-4,y); ctx.lineTo(x+4,y); ctx.moveTo(x,y-4); ctx.lineTo(x,y+4); ctx.stroke();

  function drawCollectible(c){
    // Keep the level-1 collectible art for every stage so stars and feathers
    // never change size or visual identity between levels.
    if(level1AssetsReady() && (c.type==='star' || c.type==='feather')){
      const pulse=1+Math.sin(c.phase)*.05, rot=Math.sin(c.phase)*.12;
      if(c.type==='star'){
        const rect=HD_L1_RECTS.stars[(c.phase*10|0)%HD_L1_RECTS.stars.length];
        drawSpriteCenter(HD_L1.fx,rect,c.x,c.y,.15*pulse,rot,1,false,.5,.5);
      } else {
        const rect=HD_L1_RECTS.feathers[(c.phase*10|0)%HD_L1_RECTS.feathers.length];
        drawSpriteCenter(HD_L1.fx,rect,c.x,c.y,.13*pulse,rot,.98,false,.5,.5);
      }
      return;
    }
    // Safe fallback while the HD sheet is loading.
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(c.x,c.y); ctx.rotate(Math.sin(c.phase)*0.15);
    if(c.type==='star'){
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffd12f'; ctx.strokeStyle='#ffb700'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
      starPath(0,0,18,9,5); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle='#f8fbff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-4,-18); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(18,-8,3,18); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-15,8,-4,-18); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(153,186,214,.55)'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-2,-14); ctx.lineTo(0,12); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function starPath(x,y,r1,r2,n){
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let i=0;i<n*2;i++){
      const a = -Math.PI/2 + i*Math.PI/n;
      const r = i%2===0 ? r1 : r2;
      const px = x + Math.cos(a)*r, py = y + Math.sin(a)*r;
      if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
  }

      ctx.fillStyle='#5a3f32'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-14,-20); ctx.lineTo(-4,-33); ctx.lineTo(-1,-18); ctx.fill(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(14,-20); ctx.lineTo(4,-33); ctx.lineTo(1,-18); ctx.fill();
    } else {

      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(9,1); ctx.lineTo(34,18+wing*6); ctx.lineTo(14,9); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#f8fbff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-2,6,12,7,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-10,-4,7,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#151b29'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-12,-4,3.3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-13,-5,1,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#ff5575'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-23,-2); ctx.lineTo(-40,3); ctx.lineTo(-23,8); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  function drawStormFaceOverlay(level4=false,boss=false){
    const eyeY = boss ? 2 : 5;
    const sep = boss ? 18 : 14;
    const glow = level4 ? 'rgba(255,84,84,.95)' : 'rgba(255,192,60,.94)';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = glow;
    ctx.shadowBlur = level4 ? 18 : 12;
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-sep, eyeY, boss ? 7 : 5.5, boss ? 5.5 : 4.5, -.18, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(sep, eyeY + 1, boss ? 7 : 5.5, boss ? 5.5 : 4.5, .18, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(35,10,16,.78)';
    ctx.lineWidth = boss ? 5 : 4;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-sep - 10, eyeY - 9); ctx.lineTo(-sep + 3, eyeY - 4);
    ctx.moveTo(sep + 10, eyeY - 8); ctx.lineTo(sep - 3, eyeY - 3);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = level4 ? 'rgba(255,125,85,.96)' : 'rgba(255,194,70,.94)';
    ctx.lineWidth = boss ? 5.5 : 4.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-18, 24); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, boss ? 39 : 35, 18, 24);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawLightningStrikeFancy(len, level4=false, boss=false){
    const main = [[0,0],[10,len*.14],[-8,len*.32],[12,len*.52],[-4,len*.76],[6,len]];
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = level4 ? 'rgba(164,218,255,.92)' : 'rgba(255,232,115,.88)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = level4 ? 42 : 30;
    ctx.strokeStyle = level4 ? 'rgba(180,228,255,.94)' : '#ffe257';
    ctx.lineWidth = boss ? 10 : (level4 ? 8.5 : 7.5);
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(main[0][0], main[0][1]);
    for(let i=1;i<main.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(main[i][0], main[i][1]);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.96)';
    ctx.lineWidth = boss ? 4.6 : 3.4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(main[0][0], main[0][1]);
    for(let i=1;i<main.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(main[i][0], main[i][1]);
    ctx.stroke();
    const branchAlpha = level4 ? .72 : .52;
    for(const b of [[2, -18, len*.46],[3, 16, len*.68]]){
      ctx.strokeStyle = level4 ? `rgba(185,228,255,${branchAlpha})` : `rgba(255,231,120,${branchAlpha})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = boss ? 4 : 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(main[b[0]][0], main[b[0]][1]);
      ctx.lineTo(main[b[0]][0] + b[1], b[2]);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${branchAlpha})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = boss ? 1.8 : 1.4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(main[b[0]][0], main[b[0]][1]);
      ctx.lineTo(main[b[0]][0] + b[1], b[2]);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawStorm(o){
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(o.x,o.y);
    const isBoss=o.type==='boss', level7=isLevel7HD(), level6=isLevel6HD(), level5=isLevel5HD(), level4=isLevel4HD(), level3=isLevel3HD(), flash=o.warn>0?.92+Math.sin(state.time*28)*.08:1;

    else if(level4&&level4AssetsReady()){const rect=HD_L4_RECTS.storms[(o.variant||0)%HD_L4_RECTS.storms.length];drawSpriteCenter(HD_L4.pack,rect,0,0,o.big?.35:.32,0,flash,false,.5,.5);hd=true;}
    else if(level5&&level5AssetsReady()){const rect=HD_L4_RECTS.storms[(o.variant||0)%HD_L4_RECTS.storms.length];ctx.save();ctx.filter='hue-rotate(22deg) saturate(1.35) brightness(.82) contrast(1.18)';drawSpriteCenter(HD_L4.pack,rect,0,0,o.big?.37:.33,Math.sin(state.time*2+o.phase)*.018,flash,false,.5,.5);ctx.restore();hd=true;}
    else if(level6&&level6AssetsReady()){const rect=HD_L4_RECTS.storms[(o.variant||0)%HD_L4_RECTS.storms.length];ctx.save();ctx.filter='hue-rotate(165deg) saturate(.92) brightness(.76) contrast(1.12)';drawSpriteCenter(HD_L4.pack,rect,0,0,o.big?.35:.32,Math.sin(state.time*1.7+o.phase)*.015,flash,false,.5,.5);ctx.restore();hd=true;}
    else if(level7&&level7AssetsReady()){const rect=HD_L4_RECTS.storms[(o.variant||0)%HD_L4_RECTS.storms.length];ctx.save();ctx.filter='hue-rotate(170deg) saturate(.55) brightness(1.12) contrast(1.06)';drawSpriteCenter(HD_L4.pack,rect,0,0,o.big?.35:.32,Math.sin(state.time*1.6+o.phase)*.014,flash,false,.5,.5);ctx.restore();hd=true;}
    if(level4||level5||level6||level7){
      ctx.save();
      const aura=ctx.createRadialGradient(0,2,18,0,16,isBoss?98:74);
      aura.addColorStop(0,level5?'rgba(162,126,255,.18)':level7?'rgba(210,242,255,.18)':level6?'rgba(130,185,255,.16)':'rgba(125,165,255,.12)'); aura.addColorStop(.56,level5?'rgba(105,111,255,.12)':level7?'rgba(155,215,245,.12)':level6?'rgba(72,105,180,.10)':'rgba(108,132,255,.08)'); aura.addColorStop(1,'rgba(30,40,72,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle=aura; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,18,isBoss?98:74,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
    if(!hd)drawStormCloudLocal(0,0,isBoss?1.45:1,flash,isBoss);
    if(level4 || level5 || level6 || level7 || !hd) drawStormFaceOverlay(level4||level5||level6||level7,isBoss);
    if(o.warn>0){
      const pulse=.20+Math.sin(state.time*28)*.12;
      ctx.fillStyle=(level4||level5||level6||level7)?`rgba(168,215,255,${pulse})`:`rgba(255,244,173,${.15+Math.sin(state.time*28)*.10})`;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,16,isBoss?82:((level4||level5||level6||level7)?64:52),0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    }
    if(o.bolt>0){
      drawLightningStrikeFancy(o.boltLen,level4||level5||level6||level7,isBoss);
      if(level4||level5||level6||level7){
        ctx.fillStyle=level5?'rgba(190,205,255,.14)':level6?'rgba(185,220,255,.11)':'rgba(210,236,255,.10)';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,o.boltLen*.92,46,10,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawStormCloudLocal(x,y,s,alpha,boss){

    g.addColorStop(0,boss?'#7a5eff':'#6c7794'); g.addColorStop(.58,boss?'#4b31a6':'#43536f'); g.addColorStop(1,boss?'#2c205f':'#202f46');

    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(37,17,22,.65)'; ctx.lineWidth=4; ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-24,-2); ctx.lineTo(-8,2); ctx.moveTo(24,0); ctx.lineTo(8,4); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,190,35,.95)'; ctx.lineWidth=5; ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-20,30); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,36,20,30); ctx.stroke();

  function drawPlayer(){
    if(state.bonusType && drawFeatherBonusPlayer()) return;
    if(state.mode!=='endless'&&state.levelIndex<=6&&level1AssetsReady()){
      const p=state.player;if(!p)return;const bob=Math.sin(p.bob)*3,pose=p.hit?3:(p.wink>0||p.blink>0?2:(p.vy<-60?1:0)),rect=HD_L1_RECTS.player[pose],rot=p.hit?p.rot+p.deadRot:p.rot;
      ctx.save();ctx.translate(p.x,p.y+bob);ctx.rotate(rot);ctx.shadowColor='rgba(24,94,142,.20)';ctx.shadowBlur=18;ctx.shadowOffsetY=8;const [sx,sy,sw,sh]=rect,sc=pose===1?.24:.235,dw=sw*sc,dh=sh*sc;ctx.drawImage(HD_L1.player,sx,sy,sw,sh,-dw*.48,-dh*.56,dw,dh);ctx.restore();return;
    }
    const p = state.player; if(!p) return;
    const bob = Math.sin(p.bob)*3;
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(p.x, p.y+bob); ctx.rotate(p.hit ? p.rot+p.deadRot : p.rot);
    ctx.shadowColor='rgba(26,95,155,.23)'; ctx.shadowBlur=16; ctx.shadowOffsetY=8;
    const body = ctx.createRadialGradient(-8,-12,2,0,8,46); body.addColorStop(0,'#ffffff'); body.addColorStop(.64,'#ffffff'); body.addColorStop(1,'#badff8');
    ctx.fillStyle=body;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,38,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.arc(-28,8,18,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.arc(28,12,16,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.arc(-10,32,12,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.arc(18,30,10,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowColor='transparent';

    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(-30,8); ctx.rotate(-0.35 - Math.sin(state.time*7)*0.12); ctx.strokeStyle='#ffffff'; ctx.lineWidth=9; ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,0); ctx.lineTo(-19,6); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore();
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(20,-18); ctx.rotate(0.05 + p.umbrellaTilt); ctx.strokeStyle='#28344b'; ctx.lineWidth=7; ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,0); ctx.lineTo(12,-46); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle='#1b2435'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,7,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();

    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(32,-64); ctx.rotate(p.umbrellaTilt);
    const ug = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,-42,0,4); ug.addColorStop(0,'#fff46e'); ug.addColorStop(.4,'#ffde22'); ug.addColorStop(.74,'#ffbf18'); ug.addColorStop(1,'#f09a09');
    ctx.fillStyle=ug; ctx.strokeStyle='#e79200'; ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-56,-10); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-38,-40,0,-44); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(35,-40,54,-10); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(37,-15,19,-7); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,-17,-18,-8); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-36,-16,-56,-10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.62)'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-8,-33); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(9,-39,25,-31); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    drawFace(p);
    if(p.cheer>0){
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffd229'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-42,-26); ctx.lineTo(-26,-18); ctx.lineTo(-39,-6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-20,-34); ctx.lineTo(-8,-24); ctx.lineTo(-19,-13); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  function drawFace(p){
    if(p.mood==='dead'){
      ctx.strokeStyle='#101722'; ctx.lineWidth=4; ctx.lineCap='round';
      for(const xx of [-12,12]){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(xx-5,-8); ctx.lineTo(xx+5,3); ctx.moveTo(xx+5,-8); ctx.lineTo(xx-5,3); ctx.stroke(); }
      ctx.fillStyle='#db3358'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(2,14,9,Math.PI,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      return;
    }
    if(p.blink>0 && p.mood!=='panic' && p.mood!=='worried' && p.wink<=0){
      ctx.strokeStyle='#111722'; ctx.lineWidth=3.4; ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-20,-5); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-12,-1,-4,-5); ctx.moveTo(5,-5); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(13,-1,21,-5); ctx.stroke();
    } else if(p.wink>0){
      ctx.strokeStyle='#111722'; ctx.lineWidth=3.4; ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-20,-5); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-12,-1,-4,-5); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle='#111722'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(12,-4,4.5,7.4,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    } else if(p.mood==='worried'){
      ctx.strokeStyle='#111722'; ctx.lineWidth=3.4; ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-20,-12); ctx.lineTo(-8,-7); ctx.moveTo(20,-12); ctx.lineTo(8,-7); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle='#111722'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-10,-2,4,7,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.ellipse(10,-2,4,7,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle='#f05d7d'; ctx.lineWidth=3.2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,14,6,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
    } else if(p.mood==='panic'){
      ctx.strokeStyle='#111722'; ctx.lineWidth=3.8; ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-21,-13); ctx.lineTo(-9,-6); ctx.moveTo(21,-13); ctx.lineTo(9,-6); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle='#111722'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-10,-2,4,8,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.ellipse(10,-2,4,8,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#f1486e'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,15,9,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle='#111722'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-12,-4,4.4,7.2,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.ellipse(11,-4,4.4,7.2,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#f04a71'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,12,p.mood==='joy'?10:8,0,Math.PI); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawParticles(){
    for(const p of state.particles){
      ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
      if(p.type==='puff'){
        const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x,p.y,1,p.x,p.y,p.r); g.addColorStop(0,'#fff'); g.addColorStop(1,'#bfe8ff'); ctx.fillStyle=g;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      } else if(p.type==='star'){
        ctx.fillStyle='#ffd032'; starPath(p.x,p.y,p.r,p.r*.45,5); ctx.fill();
      } else if(p.type==='sun'){
        ctx.fillStyle='#ffe26b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r*.7,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      } else if(p.type==='bonus'){
        const col=((p.bonusType&&FEATHER_BONUSES[p.bonusType])?FEATHER_BONUSES[p.bonusType].color:(state.bonusType&&FEATHER_BONUSES[state.bonusType]?FEATHER_BONUSES[state.bonusType].color:'#ffe671'));
        ctx.fillStyle=col; ctx.shadowColor=col; ctx.shadowBlur=8; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r*.55,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r*.5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
    for(const s of state.sparks){
      ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = s.life*2.5; ctx.fillStyle='#fff9ac'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawGame(){
    const theme = state.mode==='endless' ? 'day' : levelTheme(state.levelIndex).theme;
    drawBg(theme);
    state.collectibles.forEach(drawCollectible);
    state.obstacles.forEach(o => (o.type==='storm' || o.type==='boss') ? drawStorm(o) : drawBird(o));
    drawParticles();
    if(!(state.invuln>0 && Math.floor(state.time*12)%2===0)) drawPlayer();
    drawBonusVisuals();

    if(state.paused){
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.06)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    }
  }

  function loop(now){
    const dt = Math.min(.033, Math.max(0,(now - state.lastTick)/1000));
    state.lastTick = now;
    update(dt);
    drawGame();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  function renderHeroPreview(){
    const holder = document.getElementById('heroPreview');
    holder.innerHTML = '';
  }
